Specification of Diagnostics
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
[SWS_DM_02025] Reporting failed authentication to IdsM
Upstream requirements:
RS_Ids_00810
⌈
If a diagnostic service Authentication is received, which results in a negative re-
sponse, the DM shall report a security event SEV_UDS_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED
to IdsM (see [26] and table [SWS_DM_02026]) with the context data given in
[SWS_DM_02026].
⌋
[SWS_DM_02026] Security event context data definition: SEV_UDS_AUTHENTI-
CATION_FAILED
